repair_contexts.method: Two changed defects in the three-module contracts from experiment 38. The older defects were fixed first. Seven public cases and 72 held-out cases per bug verified on each corrected implementation. Entries receive prepared projects and example inputs. Timing includes local process start, test and diagnostic generation. No model call. Python uses the external AST context builder from experiment 38 outside TIDE; the working directory replaces its sandbox mount. Python emits spaced JSON. Both raw tool and normalized payload tokens recorded.

locator.contract: Given an origin and a list of coordinates, return the coordinate at minimum absolute distance. If several coordinates are equally near, return the smallest coordinate. Empty input returns the origin. Coordinates are integers between -10000 and 10000 inclusive.

tide.panel.tide:
use choice

locate origin:i marks:*i > i
case (at marks 0) origin initial (fold marks initial current row item (choose origin current item))
tide.choice.tide:
use geometry

choose origin:i current:i item:i > i
let old distance origin current
let fresh distance origin item
if (< fresh old) item (if (eq fresh old) (if (< item current) item current) current)
tide.geometry.tide:
distance origin:i mark:i > i
let delta - mark origin
if (< delta 0) (+ 1 (- 0 delta)) delta

separation a:i b:i > b
< a b

dial.contract: Given a reading, a reference and a positive spacing, return the closest grid value reference + k * spacing for integer k. If a reading is exactly halfway between two grid values, choose the grid value farther from the reference. Inputs are integers: reading and reference in [-10000,10000], spacing in [1,100].

tide.panel.tide:
use scale

display reading:i reference:i spacing:i > i
+ reference (scale (- reading reference) spacing)
tide.scale.tide:
use units

scale delta:i width:i > i
let magnitude if (< delta 0) (- 0 delta) delta
let rounded * width (units magnitude width)
if (< delta 0) (- 0 (* width (div magnitude width))) rounded
tide.units.tide:
units magnitude:i width:i > i
let whole div magnitude width
let rest mod magnitude width
if (< (* 2 rest) width) whole (+ whole 1)

multiple value:i width:i > b
eq (mod value width) 0

python.scale.py:
from units import units

def scale(delta, width):
    magnitude = -delta if delta < 0 else delta
    rounded = width * units(magnitude, width)
    return -(width * (magnitude // width)) if delta < 0 else rounded
